ops.title: capt-hook hook path should exec binrun directly, skipping the shell launcher
ops.description: capt-hook/hooks/common.py:14-22 points BUNDLED at the bash launcher. Preferring the resolved Go binrun removes the shell entirely from the hook path. Measured 662ms -> ~15ms (44x); 7.48s -> 0.08s at 24-way (94x), rc=0 verified. Compounds with the dirname fix but supersedes it on this path.

ops.text: falls back to the bash launcher when binrun is absent (cold machine)
